sources.unique_value: Fresh Kraken ticker/OHLC rechecks and deterministic condition truth where an event wakeup requires current confirmation.
sources.overlap_strategy: Used for bounded confirmation/context, not as a second continuous raw archive.

sources.unique_value: Kraken-native public futures mark/funding/open-interest context for the same asset family.
sources.overlap_strategy: Preferred derivatives context when available; Binance is supplementary/fallback cross-market context.

sources.unique_value: Independent cross-market funding/open-interest context when it adds information unavailable from Kraken Futures.
sources.overlap_strategy: Supplementary only; never replaces Kraken-EUR execution truth. Physical MINI-PC public connectivity is proven HEALTHY on 2026-10-02; research use still requires a preregistered point-in-time trial.

sources.unique_value: Independent external alert/wakeup transport that can accelerate same-pair Kraken fresh rechecks.
sources.overlap_strategy: Redundant trigger path by design; Kraken public data remains condition truth and GitHub/Kraken-native paths remain independent.

sources.unique_value: Official macro/regulatory headline context without relying on unverified social/news summaries.
sources.overlap_strategy: Context only; not a complete news feed and not archived as a second news database.

sources.unique_value: Official Kraken historical OHLCVT provenance for point-in-time EUR replay and reproducible historical research.
sources.overlap_strategy: OHLCVT is default research source; trade-level data is only justified for questions OHLCVT cannot answer.

sources.unique_value: Trade-level timing/flow for targeted fill and microstructure questions that OHLCVT cannot answer.
sources.overlap_strategy: Full archive remains blocked by a storage-benefit gate; use only targeted questions/windows if later authorized.

sources.unique_value: Official Federal Reserve schedule and release timing for FOMC policy events used to define point-in-time macro risk windows.
sources.overlap_strategy: Calendar supplies known scheduled event timing; headline source supplies released official content. They are complementary, not duplicate raw archives.

sources.unique_value: Public no-key network metrics with heterogeneous fixed coverage and two persisted prospective known-at cycles. retrieved_at is usable as a conservative prospective known-at upper bound; AssetEODCompletionTime is not exact per-metric finality and historical backfill remains blocked.
sources.overlap_strategy: V3 H8 state/confirmation source only. Prospective-only compact capture may proceed under fixed assets/metrics with retrieved_at preserved and missingness fail-closed. Historical performance/backfill is not authorized by the two-cycle evidence.

sources.unique_value: Public Hyperliquid leaderboard snapshot used only to discover a broad reproducible candidate-address pool before official public Info-endpoint verification.
sources.overlap_strategy: Stats leaderboard is discovery-only and its undocumented response shape is validated each run. Official api.hyperliquid.xyz/info verifies public-address role/portfolio/fills before cohort inclusion. No Kraken outcomes enter selection.
sources.persistence_mode: one frozen cohort-selection provenance snapshot; no continuous leaderboard archive

sources.unique_value: Public Hyperliquid market/account activity context (including public-address open orders/fills) that can test whether trader activity leads later Kraken-EUR moves.
sources.overlap_strategy: Potential H10 independent trader-activity sensor only; never replaces Kraken market truth or derivatives context. Wallet selection must be separately preregistered and cannot be chosen by seen Kraken performance.
sources.persistence_mode: exact deduplicated fill events max 48h; compact 5m wallet/asset aggregates + wallet-state/capture health max 120d; frozen cohort/contracts immutable; no full exchange archive

sources.unique_value: Public event/market metadata plus CLOB prices/order books can provide point-in-time probability, spread, liquidity and change context for event-risk research.
sources.overlap_strategy: H11 event-state sensor only. Official sources remain authoritative for scheduled/released facts; Polymarket measures market-implied state. Two identical-code bounded captures show state changes are observable (10/10 book hashes changed and timestamps advanced over 24.5s), but midpoint/spread did not change in that short interval and predictive value remains entirely unproven.

sources.unique_value: Independent global crypto market-cap/24h-volume/BTC-dominance and large-cap cross-check; connected data tool read succeeded 2026-10-08.
sources.overlap_strategy: Read alongside CoinMarketCap only to triangulate aggregate regime; methodology and source observation timestamp differ; no two-vote signal.

sources.unique_value: Independent global crypto capitalization/dominance, sentiment and optional altcoin-season gauge. Connected tool read succeeded 2026-10-08; its returned as-of timestamp must be respected.
sources.overlap_strategy: A second context estimate, not a second independent truth or a vote for trade rejection; freshness and definitional mismatches cause UNKNOWN context.

sources.unique_value: Supplementary global funding/open-interest/liquidation imbalance view; connected read succeeded 2026-10-08, but reporting units and market aggregation must be checked before any decision use.
sources.overlap_strategy: Only corroborates already registered Kraken/Binance derivatives and H2 research, not an independent trade rule; suspicious units = NOT_EVALUABLE.

sources.unique_value: Convenient secondary aggregation of upcoming economic calendar entries; connected tool read succeeded 2026-10-08, but third-party news snippets cannot override official Fed/BLS statements.
sources.overlap_strategy: Only a discovery hint and link. Resolve date/release at official primary source before relying on time or facts.

sources.unique_value: Independent public Coinbase spot volume and spread/price plausibility cross-check for liquid Kraken EUR candidate contexts; previously requested, not proven as runtime feed.
sources.overlap_strategy: On-demand only for liquid high-quality candidate or Kraken-data anomaly; never make missing Coinbase support a blocker.

sources.unique_value: CFTC digital-asset market rules, enforcement, derivatives oversight and material regulatory changes as primary-source risk/event context.
sources.overlap_strategy: Complement existing official Fed/SEC context; skip routine unrelated administrative press releases.

sources.unique_value: Official US BLS CPI, jobs, PPI and employment-release dates and published facts relevant to risk-asset event timing.
sources.overlap_strategy: Official BLS schedule/content overrides third-party macro calendar hints; check within scheduled event windows.

sources.unique_value: Official Treasury/OFAC crypto-related sanctions, stablecoin or financial-system measures only when directly relevant to tradability/custody/crypto conditions.
sources.overlap_strategy: Material direct crypto relevance only; not a broad geopolitical or world-news monitor.

sources.unique_value: Official Kraken and, when corroboration is useful, Coinbase exchange listing, delisting, outage and asset-operation notices as risk/tradability context.
sources.overlap_strategy: Current online Kraken AssetPairs stays live tradability truth; exchange notices supplement upcoming status or operational incidents.

sources.unique_value: CoinMarketCal/Tokenomist/Messari and direct project sources can discover material token unlocks, emissions, forks and protocol events for candidate-specific review.
sources.overlap_strategy: Require primary project/exchange/tokenomics confirmation before high-stakes timing; no blanket unlock veto.

sources.unique_value: USD index, US Treasury yield and Nasdaq/liquidity context previously proposed to contextualize crypto risk-on/risk-off; market clocks and correlation are variable.
sources.overlap_strategy: Only use when a macro move materially explains regime or event exposure; no naive BTC-vs-USD level comparison.

sources.unique_value: Arkham/Nansen/Binance public trader activity are optional later H10 confirmations when they add unique reproducible signals beyond current Hyperliquid capture.
sources.overlap_strategy: Use Hyperliquid H10 as existing lead; Arkham/Nansen subscriptions never automatically purchased; no new wallet, account or data rights.
